A Recomputed Block Beside a Structural Term, in the Outer Gradient

Source: R/outer_refresh.R
structural_refresh_move.Rd

Returns what the exact outer gradient of the structural branch (statmod_structural_grad()) needs where a term recomputes its block at the coefficients (modelterms7::nl(), a smoothed modelterms7::seg()): the block's second-derivative term of the likelihood's curvature, by which the mode moves, and the movement of \(K\) with the block.

Usage

structural_refresh_move(spec, design, coef, jd)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec().

design

The design, refreshed at coef.

coef

The coefficients at the mode.

jd

The joint rows, from joint_design_rows().

Value

NULL where no term recomputes its block; otherwise a list with Dm, a matrix over the coefficients, and trace, a function of the direction over the joint vector and of \(M\).

Details

The criterion's \(K\) is assembled on the block at the mode and, as on the route without a structural term, leaves out the term \(\sum_t\sum_q g_{q,t}\,\partial^2\eta^{\rm s}_{q,t}/\partial u^2\) that the second derivative of the static predictors \(\eta^{\rm s}\) contributes to the likelihood's curvature. The mode moves by the full curvature, so Dm is that term, from mode_curvature() with \(g_{q,t}\) the total derivative of the log-likelihood in the static predictor (the score plus the filter's reverse pass, statmod_score_obs()); the filter carries the block's second derivative into later levels through that reverse pass.

Along a direction \(v\) the static rows move by \(D = \partial X/\partial u\,[v]\) (modelterms7::term_block_deriv()), and \(K\) moves through the filter's Jacobian and curvature, which the recursion computes from those rows. At fixed predictors and filter parameters \(K\) is a polynomial of degree two in the rows: the Jacobian is affine in them, and the curvature and \(\sum H V^\top V\) are quadratic. Its derivative along \(D\) is therefore exactly \((K(V + sD) - K(V - sD))/(2s)\) for any \(s\), which trace() takes against \(M\) with \(s\) scaling \(D\) to the size of \(V\). The movement of \(K\) through the predictors and the filter's parameters is read by structural_grad_parts() and structural_chain_extra().

See also

u_refresh(), the same movement on the route without a structural term.
